spans.s:
श्रौत f. ई (आ) relating to the ears, based upon sound or
words (w. उपमा f. an explicit comparison);
 relating to sacred
tradition, Vedic.

श्रौतसूत्र^1 n. a Sūtra work based upon sacred
tradition.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
श्रौत्र॑ f. ई॑ relating to the ear.
स्रौच a. performed with the Sruc.
स्रौतोवह a. relating to a stream.
